integrity: The analytic proof uses the exact postselection factor, the uniform Renyi-to-relative-entropy expansion, and the fidelity inequality proved in arXiv:2610.02176v1. The included verifier checks only the new algebraic optimization and does not replace those operator-theoretic premises.
scientific_limitations: The converse assumes full permutation invariance of the n-use channel input.
The code statement is for the pure-source entanglement-generation class (and isometric-encoder entanglement transmission) treated by the primary source, not arbitrary mixed encoders.
No optimality of the square-root-logarithmic window, constants, or unrestricted quantum-capacity threshold is claimed.
The channel-dependent uniform Taylor constants are finite but are not numerically evaluated for individual channels.
title: Optimized Rényi postselection gives a moderate-deviation converse window for permutation-symmetric quantum codes
